intended_object: The connecting homomorphism Hⁿ(X₁) → Hⁿ⁺¹(X₄) of the cohomological Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence for a pushout square of simplicial sets X₁ → X₂, X₃ → X₄ whose top map is a monomorphism. Cohomology is taken with coefficients Hom(C(−;R), M). This is read off the docstring and the module documentation, which cites Hatcher §3.1.
explanation:
The definition takes the cochain Mayer–Vietoris short complex 0 → Hom(C(X₄),M) → Hom(C(X₂),M) ⊞ Hom(C(X₃),M) → Hom(C(X₁),M) → 0. Its maps are (r^*, b^*) and t^* − l^*. The library proves this complex is short exact when the square is a pushout and t is mono. The definition then applies Mathlib's `ShortComplex.ShortExact.δ`, the snake-lemma connecting map of the homology long exact sequence.

The cochain complexes are indexed by ℕ with the upward shape, so the relation `n + 1 = m` is exactly the condition `δ` needs. The source is Hⁿ(X₁) and the target is Hᵐ(X₄), which is the standard direction of the cohomological Mayer–Vietoris connecting map. The surrounding lemmas prove exactness at every spot and naturality, which confirms it is the intended map.

The generality is the natural one. The spaces are arbitrary simplicial sets in a pushout square; the hypothesis `Mono t` is what makes the sequence short exact. The coefficients R and M lie in any k-linear abelian category with coproducts. Mathlib has no ready-made Mayer–Vietoris connecting map for cohomology.
